# temps_project_access (Resource)

Grants a team a role on a project. A team has at most one role per project.

Import with `<project_id>/<team_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `projects:read`, `projects:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_project_access" "platform_web" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  team_id    = temps_team.platform.id
  role       = "deployer"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.
- `role` (String) `owner`, `admin`, `deployer` or `viewer`. Changes in place.
- `team_id` (Number) ID of the team.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<team_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_project_access.platform_web 3/2
```
